title: Casa Verde bakery chain: results by city, 2025
bodyMd: Casa Verde operates bakery shops in four cities. The table gives, for each city, the number of shops the chain ran throughout 2025, the revenue those shops took during the year in thousands of euros, and the number of people the chain employed in that city at the end of the year.

data.caption: Casa Verde bakery chain, 2025: shops, revenue and staff in each of the four cities.

accessibilityText: A table of four rows and four columns. The columns are city, number of shops, revenue in thousands of euros, and number of staff. Arno: 6 shops, 960 thousand euros, 48 staff. Brenta: 10 shops, 1200 thousand euros, 80 staff. Carso: 6 shops, 720 thousand euros, 24 staff. Dorsa: 5 shops, 600 thousand euros, 50 staff. Across all four cities the chain ran 27 shops, took 3480 thousand euros of revenue and employed 202 people. An accompanying bar chart plots revenue only, one bar per city, tallest for Brenta at 1200 thousand euros and shortest for Dorsa at 600 thousand euros.

provenance.notes: Invented data for a fictional bakery chain in four fictional cities, written for this item set. Figures were chosen so that revenue per shop and revenue per member of staff are whole numbers in every city, so the whole table can be worked without a calculator. Not derived from any real company, dataset or published test item.
